_comment: What counts as a whole-block colour in the main Colour panel of a block over 12 base colours (check-colour-count.py --stage whole-block): the block's own background, text, heading and link colour. A row matches when its attribute (attrs.base, or the first value it reads) matches an `attributes` pattern, or, when the attribute cannot be read, its key or label matches a `labels` pattern. Everything else is a part's colour and sits in that part's panel.
